item.text:
Refactored [open_addressing_linear_probing.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/015_open_addressing_linear_probing/open_addressing_linear_probing.java) to replace raw probe bookkeeping with a richer internal `SlotResult`. The core now carries “present entry vs insertion slot” as a first-class concept, so `putResult`, `getResult`, `removeResult`, `containsKey`, reinsertion, and slot writes all use the same internal model instead of repeating `foundIndex`/`insertionIndex` checks.

That made the control flow noticeably cleaner: lookup, overwrite, insert, and remove paths now read in terms of slot state rather than probe internals. Verification passed with `javac open_addressing_linear_probing.java && java hashMap`, plus a focused check covering overwrite behavior, presence checks, removals, missing-key handling, and stored `-1` values.
